channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Japan elects fewer women MPs despite female PM’s win
item.description: Japan's lower house sees a drop in female MPs to 15%, a setback for gender equality in politics despite Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's historic re-election

item.title: Malaysia and India strengthen ties on trade, security and Myanmar
item.description: Foreign Minister Mohamad Hasan details enhanced cooperation following PM Modi's visit, covering trade, defence, tourism and a shared stance on Myanmar.

item.title: Additional ETS tickets for KL-JB route on sale from tomorrow
item.description: KTMB releases 12,600 extra ETS tickets for Chinese New Year travel between KL Sentral and JB Sentral, addressing high demand.

item.title: Malaysia negotiating terms of US tariff MoU
item.description: Foreign Minister Mohamad Hasan says Malaysia is negotiating the terms of a tariff MoU with the US, with talks led by the investment ministry.

item.title: Data digitisation key to Malaysia’s AI nation goal by 2030
item.description: Malaysia's push to become an AI nation by 2030 hinges on digitising government data, with a new policy and expanded MyGDX platform to strengthen governance.

item.title: KPDN seeks stronger enforcement against anti-competitive OTAs
item.description: KPDN calls for coordinated enforcement on OTAs over competition concerns, citing price parity and commission issues affecting hotels and consumers.

item.title: Khazanah to focus on connectivity and energy transition in 2026
item.description: Malaysia's sovereign fund Khazanah targets airports, airlines, grid resilience and renewables for growth, building on strong 2025 portfolio performance.

item.title: NRES forms special task force to strengthen environmental enforcement
item.description: The Ministry of Natural Resources forms a special task force to improve environmental governance and enforcement, addressing corruption and illegal e-waste imports.

item.title: Thai man arrested for smuggling rhino horn in meat at Bangkok airport
item.description: A Vietnamese man was arrested at Bangkok's main airport for smuggling rhino horns concealed in meat, linked to an international wildlife trafficking network

item.title: 15-year-old wins RM500,000 at catfish fishing tournament
item.description: Malaysian teen wins nearly RM500,000 at Kolam Den catfish competition, shocking family and netizens
